18956-autobiography-and-letters-of-orvil.creator: Unknown
18956-autobiography-and-letters-of-orvil.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. s parish visits had felt the sustaining comfort of his singular tenderness and sympathy in affliction, and of his counsel in distress, would have mourned for him not only as for a brother, but also a chief. Now, almost all of his own generation have passed away.

63490-the-altar-of-freedom.title: Freedom
63490-the-altar-of-freedom.creator: Mary Roberts Rinehart
63490-the-altar-of-freedom.description: A book by Mary Roberts Rinehart. I was twelve, I think, before I began to get a lump in my throat as the long line of veterans went by. I did not know exactly why I cried, except that those men and those tattered flags stood for something heroic and very sad.

arxiv-1807-10672.title: Exploring Sensitivity to NMSSM Signatures with Low Missing Transverse Energy at the LHC
arxiv-1807-10672.creator: A. Titterton, U. Ellwanger, H.U. Flaecher, S. Moretti, C.H. Shepherd-Themistocleous
arxiv-1807-10672.description: Abstract We examine scenarios in the Next-to-Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (NMSSM), where pair-produced squarks and gluinos decay via two cascades, each ending in a stable neutralino as Lightest Supersymmetric Particle (LSP) and a Standard Model (SM)-like Higgs boson, with mass spectra such that the missing transverse energy, E T miss E_{\text{T}}^{\text{miss}} , is very low.

arxiv-2011-10229.title: An ac-susceptibility study of the magnetic relaxation phenomena in antiskyrmion host tetragonal Mn-Pt(Pd)-Sn system
arxiv-2011-10229.creator: P. V. Prakash Madduri, Subir Sen, Bimalesh Giri, Dola Chakrabartty, Subhendu K. Manna, Stuart S. P. Parkin, Ajaya K. Nayak
arxiv-2011-10229.description: Abstract Here, we report an exhaustive study of the frequency-dependent ac-magnetic susceptibility of the D 2 ​ d D_{2d} symmetric Heusler system Mn-Pt(Pd)-Sn that hosts antiskyrmions over a wide temperature range. Magnetic relaxation studies using Cole-Cole formalism reveal a Debye-type relaxation with a nearly negligible distribution in relaxation times.

arxiv-2102-06043.title: Exact Algorithms for Scheduling Problems on Parallel Identical Machines with Conflict Jobs
arxiv-2102-06043.creator: Minh Hoàng Hà, Dinh Quy Ta, Trung Thanh Nguyen*
arxiv-2102-06043.description: Abstract Machine scheduling problems involving conflict jobs can be seen as a constrained version of the classical scheduling problem, in which some jobs are conflict in the sense that they cannot be proceeded simultaneously on different machines. This conflict constraint naturally arises in several practical applications and has recently received considerable attentions in the research community.

arxiv-2210-14024.title: Liouville Type Theorem about p p -harmonic 1 form, p p -harmonic map and harmonic q q form
arxiv-2210-14024.creator: Xiangzhi Cao
arxiv-2210-14024.description: Abstract In this paper, we will use the normalized intetral Ricci curvature to investigate Liouville type property of p p harmonic function on Riemannian manifold. secondly, we will use the BiRic curvature to obtian Liuville theorem for p p harmonic function or p p harmonic 1 form.

arxiv-2306-04201.title: Improving Hyperparameter Learning under Approximate Inference in Gaussian Process Models
arxiv-2306-04201.creator: Rui Li, ST John, Arno Solin
arxiv-2306-04201.description: Abstract Approximate inference in Gaussian process (GP) models with non-conjugate likelihoods gets entangled with the learning of the model hyperparameters. We improve hyperparameter learning in GP models and focus on the interplay between variational inference (VI) and the learning target.

arxiv-2306-07910.title: Long-range super-Planckian heat transfer between nanoemitters in a resonant cavity
arxiv-2306-07910.creator: Kiryl Asheichyk, Philippe Ben-Abdallah, Matthias Krüger, Riccardo Messina
arxiv-2306-07910.description: Abstract We study radiative heat transfer between two nanoemitters placed inside different types of closed cavities by means of a fluctuational-electrodynamics approach. We highlight a very sharp dependence of this transfer on cavity width, and connect this to the matching between the material-induced resonance and the resonant modes of the cavity.

arxiv-2311-07507.title: Scalar curvature for metric spaces: Defining curvature for Quantum Gravity without coordinates
arxiv-2311-07507.creator: Agustín Silva, Jesse van der Duin
arxiv-2311-07507.description: Abstract Geometrical properties of spacetime are difficult to study in non-perturbative approaches to quantum gravity like Causal Dynamical Triangulations (CDT), where one uses simplicial manifolds to define the gravitational path integral, instead of Riemannian manifolds. In particular, in CDT one only relies on two mathematical tools, a distance measure and a volume measure.

arxiv-2403-03897.title: Fuzzing BusyBox: Leveraging LLM and Crash Reuse for Embedded Bug Unearthing
arxiv-2403-03897.creator: Asmita, Yaroslav Oliinyk, Michael Scott, Ryan Tsang, Chongzhou Fang, Houman Homayoun
arxiv-2403-03897.description: Abstract BusyBox, an open-source software bundling over 300 essential Linux commands into a single executable, is ubiquitous in Linux-based embedded devices. Vulnerabilities in BusyBox can have far-reaching consequences, affecting a wide array of devices. This research, driven by the extensive use of BusyBox, delved into its analysis.

arxiv-2403-07134.title: COMQ: A Backpropagation-Free Algorithm for Post-Training Quantization
arxiv-2403-07134.creator: Aozhong Zhang, Zi Yang, Naigang Wang, Yingyong Qi, Jack Xin, Xin Li, Penghang Yin
arxiv-2403-07134.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aozhong Zhang, Zi Yang, Naigang Wang, Yingyong Qi, Jack Xin, Xin Li, Penghang Yin. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a practical approach to compress large neural networks, making them highly efficient for deployment. However, effectively reducing these models to their low-bit counterparts without compromising the original accuracy remains a key challenge. In this paper, we propose an innovative PTQ algorithm termed COMQ, which sequentially conducts co ordinate-wise m inimization of the layer-wise reconstruction errors.

arxiv-2503-17141.title: HiFi-Stream: Streaming Speech Enhancement with Generative Adversarial Networks
arxiv-2503-17141.creator: Ekaterina Dmitrieva, Maksim Kaledin
arxiv-2503-17141.description: Abstract Speech Enhancement techniques have become core technologies in mobile devices and voice software simplifying downstream speech tasks. Still, modern Deep Learning (DL) solutions often require high amount of computational resources what makes their usage on low-resource devices challenging. We present HiFi-Stream, an optimized version of recently published HiFi++ model.

arxiv-2509-04510.title: Combine Virtual Reality and Machine-Learning to Identify the Presence of Dyslexia: A Cross-Linguistic Approach
arxiv-2509-04510.creator: Michele Materazzini *, Gianluca Morciano, José Manuel Alcalde-Llergo, Enrique Yeguas-Bolívar, Giuseppe Calabrò, Andrea Zingoni, Juri Taborri *
arxiv-2509-04510.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michele Materazzini *, Gianluca Morciano, José Manuel Alcalde-Llergo, Enrique Yeguas-Bolívar, Giuseppe Calabrò, Andrea Zingoni, Juri Taborri *. This study explores the use of virtual reality (VR) and artificial intelligence (AI) to predict the presence of dyslexia in Italian and Spanish university students. In particular, the research investigates whether VR-derived data from Silent Reading (SR) tests and self-esteem assessments can differentiate between students that are affected by dyslexia and students that are not, employing machine learning (ML) algorithms.

Objetivo: analisar as...

pmc-10573595.title: Usefulness of AI-Equipped Endoscopy for Detecting Colorectal Adenoma during Colonoscopy Screening: Confirm That Colon Neoplasm Finely Can Be Identified by AI without Overlooking Study (Confidential Study)
pmc-10573595.creator: Kazuhiro Mizukami, Erina Fushimi, Ryota Sagami, Takashi Abe, Takao Sato, Shohei Terashi, Masahide Fukuda, Hidefumi Nishikiori, Takayuki Nagai, Masaaki Kodama, Kazunari Murakami, Faming Zhang
pmc-10573595.description: In the present prospective case series study, we investigated the lesion-detection ability of an AI-equipped colonoscopy as an addition to colonoscopy (CS) screening. Participants were 100 patients aged ≥20 years who had not undergone CS at the study site in the last 3 years and passed the exclusion criteria.

pmc-11516645.title: Regional inequalities in years of life lost within the European Economic Area: Using the Gini coefficient and slope index of inequality to assess spatial disparities
pmc-11516645.creator: O Varga, C Baravelli, J Chen-Xu, N Mahrouseh, T A Eikemo, D Grad, G Wyper, A Badache, M Balaj, P Charalampous
pmc-11516645.description: BackgroundHealth inequalities have been linked to reduced life expectations. This study aimed to investigate regional variations in all-cause years of life lost (YLLs) in European Economic Area (EEA) countries prior to the COVID-19 pandemic.MethodsDemographic data were extracted from Eurostat for 1390 small regions 32 EEA countries.

pmc-11712166.title: Navigating the Challenges of Community Supports Services: A Focus Group for Black Family Caregivers
pmc-11712166.creator: Florence U Johnson
pmc-11712166.description: This qualitative study highlights the challenges faced by Black family caregivers who provide personal care to dementia patients without remuneration or training. Caring for a person with dementia can be stressful and negatively impact the caregiver’s health. Black family caregivers are particularly vulnerable to stress‐related mental health issues.

pmc-12433503.title: Survival of patients with squamous cell carcinoma of the breast compared with invasive ductal carcinoma by biological subtype: A matched analysis of the Japanese national clinical database-breast cancer registry
pmc-12433503.creator: Mami Ogita, Hiraku Kumamaru, Makoto Kubo, Naoko Kinukawa, Naoki Niikura, Shigehira Saji, Masakazu Toi
pmc-12433503.description: PurposeOwing to the rarity of primary squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) of the breast, the prognosis of SCC remains uncertain. We aimed to investigate the clinical features and prognosis of breast SCC by subtype.MethodsA total of 350,977 patients with breast SCC or invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) were identified from the National Clinical Database-Breast Cancer Registry from 2004 to 2014.

pmc-12693671.title: UV-Activated NO2 Gas Sensing: Photoactivated Processes on the Surface of Metal Oxides
pmc-12693671.creator: Pavel Kutukov, Daria Kurtina, Sergey Maksimov, Marina Rumyantseva
pmc-12693671.description: In recent years, wide bandgap metal oxide semiconductors have become the base materials of choice for semiconductor gas sensor design. In this work, nanocrystalline ZnO, In2O3, and SnO2 were investigated when detecting NO2 under UV-photoactivation conditions. The materials were characterized by XRD, low-temperature nitrogen adsorption, and electron microscopy.

pmc-13282539.title: Expert approach to severe oligospermia in a patient with prior cryptorchidism and in vitro fertilization failure
pmc-13282539.creator: Jacob A. Brems, Robert M. Coward
pmc-13282539.description: injection cycles, each yielding only one viable embryo despite adequate oocyte yield. Hormonal evaluation reveals borderline abnormalities suggestive of impaired spermatogenesis, and genetic testing is pending. Scrotal ultrasound shows no varicocele. The couple seeks guidance to optimize assisted reproductive technology outcomes.

pmc-13286041.title: Emergency Lateral Canthotomy for Orbital Compartment Syndrome After a Motor Vehicle Collision at a Nontrauma Hospital
pmc-13286041.creator: Nicholas Brotzman, Michael Coletta, Andrew Garfield
pmc-13286041.description: We present a case of a 60-year-old female patient who presented to a community hospital emergency department after a motor vehicle collision with car intrusion, with left eye proptosis, ecchymosis, decreased left-sided extraocular movement, and progressive eye pain. Clinical findings were consistent with orbital wall fracture and retrobulbar hematoma leading to orbital compartment syndrome (OCS).

pmc-13347517.title: Obstructive sleep apnea, periodic limb movements, and REM sleep without atonia are common in Parkinson's disease and correlate with motor symptom burden
pmc-13347517.creator: Matteo Carpi, Mariangela Pierantozzi, Mariana Fernandes, Natalia Manfredi, Raffaella Ludovisi, Michela Menegotti, Tommaso Schirinzi, Rocco Cerroni, Alessandro Stefani, Nicola Biagio Mercuri, Claudio Liguori
pmc-13347517.description: BackgroundSleep disturbances are prevalent and debilitating non-motor symptoms in patients with Parkinson's disease (PD).ObjectiveThis study aimed to explore sleep architecture and the prevalence of polysomnographic (PSG) sleep findings in PD, examining the associations between sleep parameters and other clinical characteristics.MethodsThe study included 97 PD patients (age: 67.1 ± 7.9) and 42 non-PD controls (age: 64.7 ± 9.7).

pmc-13531068.title: Papillary Endothelial Hyperplasia Mimicking Right Atrial Infective Thrombus
pmc-13531068.creator: Carlos Huerta, Kristopher Aten, Darwin Nguyen, Akram Kawsara
pmc-13531068.description: BackgroundIntracardiac masses pose a diagnostic and therapeutic challenge, with clinical features overlapping infective endocarditis, thrombus, and primary cardiac tumors. Papillary endothelial hyperplasia (PEH) is a benign intravascular lesion rarely reported in intracardiac locations, potentially indistinguishable from infected thrombus on echocardiography.Case SummaryA 75-year-old man with multiple comorbidities presented in septic shock secondary to Enterococcus faecalis bacteremia.

pmc-13538474.title: Structural requirements for intelligent clinical digital twins in feedback-driven care
pmc-13538474.creator: Yanfei Wang, Glenn E. Smith, Gloria P. Lipori, Ramon C. Sun, Elizabeth A. Shenkman, Mei Liu, Yonghui Wu, Yi Guo
pmc-13538474.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Clinical digital twins are increasingly promoted for decision support, yet most are designed and validated for prediction under observed care rather than decision-support validity. We identify four structural requirements for intelligent clinical digital twins used in bidirectional clinical care. Using Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias as an example, we show how routine deployment can induce care-path-dependent epistemic drift despite stable predictive performance.

pmc-13607503.title: Presumed Hippocampal Endometriosis Presenting as Catamenial Epilepsy: Diagnostic Challenges, MRI Follow-Up, and Comparative Review of Reported Cerebral Endometriosis Case
pmc-13607503.creator: Mihaela-Camelia Tîrnovanu, Ștefan-Dragoș Tîrnovanu, Elena Cojocaru, Monica Holicov, Vlad-Constantin Donica, Roxana-Ana Covali, Awad Dmour, Norin Forna, Paul-Dan Sîrbu, Alin Ciubotaru
pmc-13607503.description: Background: Cerebral endometriosis is an exceptionally rare manifestation of extrapelvic endometriosis and remains a diagnostic challenge because its clinical and imaging features may mimic more common neurological, inflammatory, vascular, or neoplastic disorders. Catamenial neurological symptoms may provide an important diagnostic clue, but histological confirmation is rarely available.

pmc-13628650.title: Distinct responses of COL17A1 nonsense variants to readthrough drugs and NOG as a novel enhancer in junctional epidermolysis bullosa
pmc-13628650.creator: Yan Tan, Haifa El Mabrouk, Rui Zhang, Sato Magassa, Cristina Has, Saliha Beyza Sayar
pmc-13628650.description: Junctional epidermolysis bullosa (JEB) caused by COL17A1 pathogenic variants (JEB-C17) is characterized by skin fragility, chronic wounds, and an increased risk of squamous cell carcinoma. Approximately 20% of cases are caused by nonsense mutations, which induce premature termination codons (PTCs) resulting in truncated protein production and/or trigger mRNA degradation through nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) pathway.

pmc-13673643.title: Purpose in life as a predictor of capability well-being among older adults in Thailand: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13673643.creator: Yuki Kumagai, Ishtiaq Ahmad, Chitose Shimizu, Yoshihisa Shirayama, Miyoko Okamoto, Shori Takaoka, Itsaranuwat Yongpisanphop, Motoyuki Yuasa
pmc-13673643.description: IntroductionContemporary discussions on the definition of health, as highlighted by the World Health Organization (WHO), emphasize the significant role of spiritual health (SH) in contributing to overall well-being, alongside physical, mental, and social dimensions. In Thailand, the rapidly ageing population has elevated the importance of improving the well-being of older adults, making it a critical national concern.
